items.source: Returns CrudMethods meta information for the repository.
items.translation: 返回存储库的CrudMethods元信息。

items.source: Returns the TypeInformation of the id type of the repository.
items.translation: 返回存储库的 ID 类型的TypeInformation。

items.source:
Returns the set of types the repository shall be discoverable for when trying to look up a repository by domain
type.
items.translation: 返回当尝试通过域类型查找仓库时，该仓库应可被发现的类型集合。

items.source: Returns the raw domain class the repository is declared for.
items.translation: 返回仓库声明的原始域类。

items.source: Returns the raw id class the given class is declared for.
items.translation: 返回给定类所声明的原始 ID 类。

items.source: Returns the repository interface.
items.translation: 返回仓库接口。

items.source: Returns whether the repository is a paging one.
items.translation: 返回该仓库是否为分页仓库。

items.source: Returns whether the repository is a reactive one, i.e. if it uses reactive types in one of its methods.
items.translation: 返回该仓库是否为响应式仓库，即其方法中是否使用了响应式类型。

items.source: Returns the domain class returned by the given Method. In contrast to getReturnType(Method), this method extracts the type from Collections and Page as well.
items.translation: 返回给定Method所对应的域类。与getReturnType(Method)不同，此方法还会从Collection和Page中提取类型。

items.source: Returns the domain type information returned by the given Method. In contrast to getReturnType(Method), this method extracts the type from Collections and Page as well.
items.translation: 返回给定 Method 所返回的域类型信息。与 getReturnType(Method) 不同，此方法还会从 Collection 和 Page 中提取类型。

items.source: Returns the TypeInformationof the domain type the repository is declared to manage.
items.translation: 返回仓库声明为管理的域类型的TypeInformation。

items.source: Returns the domain class returned by the given Method.
items.translation: 返回由给定Method返回的域类。

items.source: Returns the domain type information returned by the given Method.
items.translation: 返回给定Method所返回的域类型信息。

items.source: Returns the type Method return type as it is declared in the repository.
items.translation: 返回仓库中声明的 Method 方法的返回类型。

items.source: Returns the TypeInformationof the domain type the repository is declared to manage. Will never be null.
items.translation: 返回仓库声明为管理的域类型的TypeInformation。永远不会为 null。

items.source: Returns the type Method return type as it is declared in the repository. Considers suspended methods and does not unwrap component types but leaves those for further inspection.
items.translation: 返回仓库中声明的 Method 返回类型。该方法会考虑挂起的（suspended）方法，并且不会解包组件类型，而是保留这些类型以供进一步检查。

items.source: Metadata for repository interfaces.
items.translation: 仓库接口的元数据。

items.source: the TypeInformation class of the identifier of the entity managed by the repository. Will never be null.
items.translation: 由仓库管理的实体的标识符的TypeInformation类。永远不会为null。

items.source: Oliver Gierke, Mark Paluch, Alessandro Nistico
items.translation: Oliver Gierke，Mark Paluch，Alessandro Nistico

items.source: the raw id class of the entity managed by the repository.
items.translation: 由仓储管理的实体的原始 ID 类。

items.source: the raw domain class the repository is handling.
items.translation: 仓库正在处理的原始领域类。

items.source: the domain class the repository is handling.
items.translation: 该仓库所处理的领域类。

items.source:
the set of types the repository shall be discoverable for when trying to look up a repository by domain
        type, must not be null.
items.translation: 当尝试通过域类型查找存储库时，该存储库可被发现的类型集合不得为 null。
